body:
P2-25 STATE, reconciled 27 Nov 2026 (replaces the 15 Nov "design only, nothing built" detail, which is false now). THE SERVER PART IS BUILT AND MERGED (all "built, not walked"); what is left is the phone's follow-up and the first real deploy.
BUILT on main: slice 1 (#104: the core `textnorm.fold/words/key_text/survives_fold_whole`, the generator and its --check, the Dart twin `app/lib/domain/text_fold.dart`, the shared fixture and corpus, the Unicode pin); slices 2 and 3 (#110, with #115's clean-up: every server call site on the one fold, `MATCHER_REVISION`, the dense-script rule, the stored keys repaired at start-up, the server REFUSES TO START on a Python whose Unicode is not 15.0.0 = the image's 3.12); slice 4 (#118: the rehome re-points files the old fold glued onto the wrong song, with its audit check and its stop-gap clock). The live repair was dry-run on a copy of VM 108's database on 16 Nov (3394 refs, 40 keys change, 15 damaged, 0 on the worklist).
NOT DEPLOYED anywhere (VM 108 runs an older image): the first real deploy runs slice 3's start-up key repair on a real database. Take a backup first, use Python 3.12 only (the dev venv C:/dev/venv-encore-server-312), and read the dry-run report before.
LEFT (all phone or held): (a) the phone's `normalizeForMatch` (app/lib/domain/text_match.dart) STILL has its own Latin-only `_fold` map: moving it onto `text_fold.dart` is "the follow-up" of slice 1 (a phone change of its own, it changes the cover cache key `CoverFallbacks.key`, so covers look up once more) = the same work as item N-46; (b) the phone's name matching of catalogue artists (B-46) is the STOP-GAP marked `STOP-GAP(P2-25 phone-matching)`, removed by P2-12 slice 8 (held by D-51 until b11); (c) B-84's phone half (the offline index's word rule for every alphabet) ships with P2-12 slice 8 and P1-16.
So: no unheld SERVER slice of P2-25 remains. The item stays todo for (a) and the deploy.
